title: 8-dollar vs $48 Vegan Cheesecake: crusts, fillings, and a taste-off

locations.name: Freeport, New York, USA
locations.basis: Explicit mention in transcript: "I'm from Freeport New York"

summary: Goodful’s video pits two vegan cheesecakes at opposite budgets: an $8 peanut butter and jelly vegan cheesecake and a $48 tahini dark chocolate caramel vegan cheesecake. Merle and Rachel guide viewers through practical, budget-conscious techniques and more luxurious ingredients, including crusts tailored to each price point, oat-milk and silken-tofu fillings, and a water-bath bake to prevent cracking. Finishing touches range from jam and peanut-butter decoration on the budget cake to a ganache-topped, tahini-caramel masterpiece with macadamia-nut crust and biscoff cookies on the premium cake. A guest judge, Joyce, provides real-time taste and value feedback, ultimately shaping a running score (Rachel 3, Merle 2) and a verdict on perceived value. The video also highlights key vegan baking tricks—homemade oat milk, miso-tanged filling, and careful hydration and crust work—presented in a friendly, repeatable format.

almighty water bath technique (foil-wrapped pan, ~1.5 inches water)
jam topping and peanut butter drizzle decoration

sections.title: Intro and Challenge Setup
concepts: Two vegan cheesecakes at different price points
Joyce as guest judge determines value
Tie-break context between Merle and Rachel
sections.description: Merle and Rachel announce a budget challenge: an $8 peanut butter and jelly vegan cheesecake and a $48 tahini dark chocolate caramel vegan cheesecake; Joyce will judge which offers better value.

sections.title: Budget Reveal and Cheap Cheesecake Plan
concepts: Graham cracker crust and prebake at 350°F / 175°C
sections.description: The teams confirm the cheap cheesecake plan and begin crust prep, including parchment lining and a graham cracker crust that is pressed into the pan before a short bake.

sections.title: Cheap Cheesecake Filling Prep and Water Bath Prep
concepts: Peanut butter, lemon juice, vanilla in filling
Foil-wrapped water bath setup to prevent cracking
sections.description: The cheap cheesecake filling is assembled from oat-milk and silken tofu base with PB, lemon, and vanilla; the pan is foiled and placed in a water bath before baking.

sections.title: Cooling, Decor, and Finalizing Cheap Cheesecake
sections.description: After baking, the cheap cheesecake chills as jam and peanut butter decorations are added, with a playful piping technique to finish the surface.

sections.title: Premium Crust Preparation
sections.description: For the premium cake, the crust is built from macadamia nuts blended with Biscoff cookies, sesame seeds, and coconut oil to form a rich base.

sections.title: Premium Filling and Assembly
concepts: Caramelized sugar flavors and sugar in filling
Tahini-caramel filling with miso, vanilla, and lemon
Kite Hill vegan cream cheese (three containers)
Water bath assembly and blending of filling
sections.description: The premium filling combines tahini, miso, and cream cheese with a caramelized sugar base; the filling is whipped with multiple tubs of cream cheese and then set in the prepared crust using a water bath.

sections.title: Top Layer Ganache, Caramel, and Finishing Touches
concepts: Swirl pattern on the top while warm
sections.description: The premium cheesecake is crowned with a glossy ganache and a tahini caramel swirl, finished with edible gold and careful topping textures.

sections.title: Joyce Tasting: First Impressions
concepts: Joyce tastes both cheesecakes without knowing which is which
Notes on vegan ingredients and crusts
sections.description: Joyce begins the taste test, offering first impressions on texture, flavor, and vegan ingredients for both the eight-dollar and the premium cakes.

sections.title: Value Verdict and Score Update
concepts: Joyce declares which cake she would choose based on value
sections.description: Joyce delivers the value verdict and the running score, highlighting which cheesecake offers better value at its price point.

sections.title: Closing Thoughts and Viewer Call-to-Action
concepts: Encouragement for viewer recipes and suggestions
sections.description: The hosts wrap up with closing remarks, invite viewer ideas for future videos, and sign off with final thoughts and a closing tune.
